workLog.outcome: Six parallel agents traced pre-commit, pre-push, pre_pr.py, CI, issue discourse, and incident history. uv startup measured 0.136 to 0.283 seconds versus 0.024 to 0.026 seconds for direct venv Python. Full actionlint measured 0.43 to 0.54 seconds versus 0.021 seconds for one workflow.

workLog.action: Removed suite-scale HEAD guard subprocess cost
workLog.outcome: The function-scoped autouse guard now reads detached or loose symbolic HEAD metadata directly and falls back to git for packed refs, reftable, non-UTF8, malformed, unsafe, or unreadable state. A 10000-call probe completed in 0.845 seconds with zero subprocess calls.

workLog.action: Scoped pre-PR lint gates without hiding pushed changes
workLog.outcome: Changed-path discovery now unions committed, staged, unstaged, and untracked NUL-delimited paths. Missing relevant worktree content fails closed with staged-deletion-aware guidance. GitHub PR-base queries share one authoritative probe per invocation and reset between runs.

Main-suite line coverage measured 438.91 seconds. Branch coverage measured 465.93 seconds and failed on mixed child data. The final design keeps main statement coverage, collects broad branch coverage in two small pin partitions, enforces target-only 100 percent gates, and projects all pin lines into one final report.

workLog.action: Proved and persisted the Lefthook stdin contract
workLog.outcome: A Lefthook 2.1.10 probe delivered identical 362604-byte stdin to three piped consumers in 5 of 5 runs. Parallel consumers corrupted all 30 large-payload deliveries across 10 runs. Canonical ci-scripts and testing rules plus Copilot mirrors record the result.

Five review rounds used GPT 5.6 Sol correctness and performance agents plus security, silent-failure, test-quality, and project-convention reviewers. Every valid finding was fixed. Final correctness, performance, test-quality, and convention reviews returned CLEAN; security approved with no exploitable or fail-open findings.
